_header_comment: Stub baseline. Stage-7 UAT (run-2026-05-13-tk5) deferred live --init-baseline because the single $2-budget probe surfaced D-tk5-04: workspace.py overrides HOME, breaking Claude Code auth (cred lookup under ~/.claude/.credentials.json). Live subprocess exited within 0.57s with subprocess-exit-1 before emitting any stream events. Fix path: keep HOME unchanged + isolate via cwd + XDG_*, OR symlink ~/.claude/.credentials.json into tmpdir HOME at setup, OR pass ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if available. See .delivery/defects/sprint-tk5.md#D-tk5-04. After D-tk5-04 lands, run: python3 delivery-team/tests/smoke/run_smoke.py --init-baseline to populate the real 5-sample mean+stddev.
deferred_reason: D-tk5-04 (HOME-isolation breaks Claude auth). One $2 live probe exited in 0.57s with subprocess-exit-1; no stream events emitted. Defer 5-sample init to follow-up after fix lands.
